release-bot: prelaunch sweep complete. prompt-eval suite flagged a small regression on summarizer-v2 -> rollout blocked by gate.
release-bot: failing metric: summary_coherence delta = -1.6% (gate threshold -1.0%). full details below.
qa-bot: attaching quick diff and failing examples. looks like edge-case truncation. :mag:
qa-bot: ```
metric,baseline,canary,delta
summary_coherence,0.912,0.898,-0.014 (-1.6%)
rougeL,0.431,0.428,-0.003 (-0.7%)
response_latency_ms,68,70,+2ms
```
sophia: thanks. is this concentrated on long-doc prompts or general?
qa-bot: mostly long-docs > 4k tokens and when conversation context includes tool outputs. failing examples: 3 out of 30.
devon: hmm. that smells like truncation at tokenization boundary after quantization change in the new build. I can reproduce locally.
anya: rollout is scheduled for the 09:00 change window (UTC) in 2h. we need decision: pin to previous model or delay.
mike: can we do a partial canary (10%) with automatic fallback to v1 if metric drops further?
release-eng: gate policy requires delta <= -1.0% across the evaluation suite. we breached so automated block stands. manual override possible with exec-level signoff.
sophia: for safety I'd prefer pin. users will notice coherence drop.
devon: quick fix: revert the tokenization tweak in runtime, rebuild, and run the failing subset. estimate 45m + re-eval 15m.
anya: timeline would push us past today's change window. prefer to postpone the rollout to tomorrow's window unless someone wants to sign an override.
mike: +1 to postpone. no biz-critical dependency.
release-eng: I'll update the release notes and close the release window for today.
release-eng: action items:
- devon revert tokenization tweak on branch release/fix-token-boundary
- qa-bot run subset-eval and post results to this thread
- release-bot hold rollout, keep pins at summarizer-v1 until green
- release-eng update changelog and customer-facing notes

release-bot: executing hold: pinned summarizer -> summarizer-v1 (deployment pin id: pin_2026_04_14_206512).
qa-bot: queued subset run; will post when finished. ETA ~20m.
sophia: thanks team. please add a short note in product changelog about defer and next window. :white_check_mark:
qa-bot: subset run complete: failing examples reduced to 0 after devon revert in local sim. posting logs: ```
run_id: 206512-sub-1
passed: 30/30
summary_coherence delta: -0.2%
```
devon: putting up PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/summarizer/pull/342
release-eng: once CI + subset-eval pass in CI, we'll approve for next window. leaving this thread open for final signoff. :eyes:
